source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A positive PHQ-9 score alone establishes a definitive diagnosis of major depression","B":"The PHQ-9 evaluates unrelated physical disorders rather than depressive symptoms","C":"The PHQ-9 replaces further assessment when a screening result is clinically positive","D":"The PHQ-9 screens depressive symptoms and estimates severity to guide further evaluation"}}
source_row.rationale: The PHQ-9 is a validated screening tool used to identify and assess the severity of depressive symptoms, helping identify clients who may benefit from further clinical evaluation and diagnosis by a qualified provider — it is a screening and severity-tracking tool, not a standalone diagnostic instrument.
source_row.source_detail: 2023 recommendation: validated depression screening instruments identify patients needing diagnostic evaluation; screening is not itself a diagnosis; accessed 2026-08-14.
